reason_for_approval: Frozen Goal C.3 explicitly requires exact scientific budget/user permission; V2 default engineering/trace COPY_ONLY permission does not include these full applications.
requested: Authorize exactly these two new full-application migration qualification starts, once each, EP before DTC, 0 auto retry/refund. Ratify the specified existing-owner accepted input/config/binary bindings and the new closed-full-SHA DTC kernel binding; no semantic/source changes.

resource_policy_rebinding_proposed.scope: Only these two native174-new qualification runs and their bounded archive/independent restore. No TLS/C16 exceptions inherited.
resource_policy_rebinding_proposed.physical_device: Same shared /dev/sdf pool; no double-count source/target free space
resource_policy_rebinding_proposed.preflight_formula: Current free >= disk floor + monitor reserve + remaining engineering reservation + both pending result/restore reservations + all actual other-project outstanding writes. Recheck before fork and during run; missing concurrent reservation evidence = HOLD.
resource_policy_rebinding_proposed.per_run_memory_caps: EP8GiB, DTC16GiB, both include local process tree; no concurrent science starts. Retain cgroup actual headroom and other project reservations.
resource_policy_rebinding_proposed.IO: Existing EP/DTC owner warning-only policy; no change to C16 IO10. No cache drops/host changes/task preemption.

epoch_and_source_boundary: Qualification runs use a single native qualification entry/lock. Formal NATIVE_SCIENCE_ACTIVE only after each scientific PASS and source owner/active-task/ledger preimage checks; management epoch1 retained. No source simulator invocation, no original file removal.
timing: EP baseline approximately12min CPU; DTC accepted baseline roughly4.5h. These are history, not promised current runtimes.
